meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 会对你的计划或设计做一轮持续追问式的访谈，帮你想清楚方案，并在过程中同步产出 ADR 和术语表文档。
howto.when: 需要你主动调用：原技能设置了 disable-model-invocation，Claude 不会自动接管；当你想打磨一份计划或设计时用它。

say.note: 开始追问，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表

say.text: 就这份计划继续追问我，别放过含糊的地方
say.note: 继续追问，直到模糊点被说清

say.text: 把刚才的取舍写成 ADR
say.note: 按讨论内容产出 ADR 文档

howto.what_en: It runs a relentless interview-style grilling on your plan or design and creates docs (ADRs and a glossary) along the way.
howto.when_en: You must invoke it yourself: it sets disable-model-invocation, so Claude won't take over on its own. Use it when sharpening a plan or design.

say_en.note: Starts the interview and builds ADRs and a glossary

say_en.text: Keep grilling me on this plan
say_en.note: Keeps questioning until vague spots are clear

say_en.text: Write our trade-offs up as an ADR
say_en.note: Produces an ADR doc from the discussion
